caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Source-bound start, material-intermediate, and near-complete frames were extracted from the original local GIF and visually inspected; metadata came from that same source file.

motion_sampling.method: Three source-bound frame samples extracted from the original local GIF for review; no derivative was added to the corpus.
motion_sampling.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

visual_anatomy.title: A two-line ‘How to’ promise uses two large rough-display word groups inside lavender tags, followed by a single-sentence scope clarifier.
visual_anatomy.layout: An orthogonal, looping process route snakes down the page between a circular start and end. Eight rectangular step nodes alternate left and right of the route.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Title and scope → start node → follow the continuous connector through each named stage → final post/end node.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large open sans title, hand-drawn-style emphasis tags, bold step headings, and smaller descriptive lines inside the completed step cards.
visual_anatomy.colour: White ground with a lavender route/endpoints; completed cards alternate restrained lavender, pink, blue, aqua, coral, and green fills.
visual_anatomy.surface: Thin black connectors, rounded cards with coloured outlines, soft diffuse shadows, and a deliberately spacious one-column canvas.
visual_anatomy.modules: One continuous route, two circular terminals, and eight repeatable process cards whose detailed copy is secondary to the path.
visual_anatomy.density: Moderate: the individual steps have breathing room, so movement along the route remains easy to trace.

motion.observed_state_change: The source starts with the full route and placeholder step labels. By the intermediate sample, the upper and middle nodes have become filled, shadowed cards with explanatory copy; by the near-complete sample the remaining lower nodes are filled too while the route stays fixed.
motion.motion_job: Stage an ordered workflow from bare structure to usable detail without making the route itself disappear.
motion.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Understand both the order of a workflow and the tangible output or question attached to each step.
transferable_mechanism.argument_shape: True sequential route with expanding step cards.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Show the complete path first, then reveal information-bearing step cards along that already legible path so animation clarifies sequence rather than serving as decoration.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when the action sequence is materially ordered and each stage can be described by a distinct decision, output, or filter.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the expertise-to-viral-content subject, exact multi-turn route, eight-step count, colour sequence, title cadence, card text, circular start/post labels, or rough-display lavender tags.

claim_boundary.note: The asset presents a conceptual workflow and uses an outcome-oriented headline. Its supplied caption is only associated by numeric ID; neither that association nor the implied outcome is independently verified.
